faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Mizoram University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 6 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Mizoram University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Public Administration, 1 Mass Communication, 1 Civil Engineering.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Mizoram University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 6 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs 1,500 per lecture subject to maximum Rs 50,000 per month for Public Administration, Rs 1,500 per lecture subject to maximum Rs 50,000 per month for Mass Communication, Rs 1,500 per lecture subject to maximum Rs 50,000 per month for Civil Engineering.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master's degree with 55% marks and NET/SLET/SET or Ph.D. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Engagement shall be strictly on per lecture basis. Candidates applying for more than one Department should submit separate applications.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting based on qualifications and criteria. Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engagement is on per lecture basis and subject to actual requirement of the University.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Aizawl.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Application (Annexure I); Criteria for Guest Faculty (Annexure II); Certificates/Marksheets of educational qualifications; Self-certified supporting documents.
